problemSignature.symptom: Real fixture manifests and web sample manifests used different validation key shapes, making dashboard readiness fragile.

rootCause: BoardForge had clean project manifests, but no shared product-status adapter to normalize DRC/ERC/unconnected/manufacturing evidence into web-dashboard cards and project summaries.
fixSummary: Add manifest-driven dashboard data generation that accepts real BoardForge project manifests, normalizes validation evidence, computes readiness, blockers, routing completion, and next action, and exposes a CLI writer.

testsAdded: manifest-driven dashboard data normalizes real fixture evidence

conditions: Use before rendering project cards in web UI or reports
Use when comparing golden fixtures and live generated projects
Use to avoid interpreting partial manifest fields differently across surfaces

recipe: Load one or more boardforge-project-manifest.json files.
Normalize validation fields from both simplified and detailed manifest schemas.
Compute readiness from shorts, forbidden vias, unconnected, DRC, ERC, and manufacturing-ready evidence.
Emit critical blockers and a deterministic next action.
Expose the normalized project list through dashboard JSON.
safetyRules: Do not mark a project ready unless manufacturing.ready is true and validation is clean.
Do not hide DRC/ERC warnings by using a narrower field than the source manifest provides.
Do not mutate protected user projects while generating dashboard data.

after.dashboardData: normalizes real odd-shape fixture and REV_F sample manifests
